pos.personaBrief: Renato rejects possession for its own sake ('A mim, não interessa ter 70% de posse de bola', 2020) and wants an objective, aggressive team, yet Grêmio 2017 still averaged 51-53% possession and was lethal on the counter (Trivela/Goal BR 2017).

pro.personaBrief: Build-up runs through the volantes (gremio.net 2019 training; Arthur key to the saída de bola), but the stated priority is objectivity ('Não adianta ficar tocando a bola dentro do próprio campo') and fast vertical counters with Fernandinho's pace.

est.personaBrief: Grêmio 2017 was 'envolvente', with Luan commanding midfield and finishing, and Renato promises 'seis, sete jogadores com liberdade para atacar'; freedom of expression outweighs fixed positional zones.

lar.personaBrief: Renato 'sempre gostou de utilizar pontas' and complained about lacking fast wide forwards (Trivela 2023); wide men gave depth and always had an active role (Lance 2019), though he sometimes used a diamond without wingers.

blo.personaBrief: No fixed high-press identity: Flamengo 2021 was criticised for neither high pressing nor a low block, Grêmio 2023 was loose and he accepts leaving spaces because the team is offensive, but in big games (Lanús 2017, Dortmund 2025) the team pressed aggressively and he says everyone must help defend.

mar.personaBrief: The only direct fact is the collective, non-individual plan for Neymar in 2025 (whoever was nearby marked him), with an unverified note that set-piece defence is not fully individual; this points to zonal orientation.

pla.personaBrief: Renato changes systems by opponent (3-5-2, diamond, two banks of four at Grêmio 2023; mirrored Inter's three centre-backs and used three volantes v Dortmund in 2025) and is credited for in-game changes (Pachuca 2017).

res.personaBrief: He boasts of playing the best football in Brazil but says 'o objetivo é jogarmos bem e ganharmos'; his teams 'jogar para dentro, sempre para vencer' as a big club, and he is pragmatic about getting results.

sis.personaBrief: Player-centred: a 'fora de série' who scores two or three a game is released from marking (stated view), and his strength is freedom and dialogue with players rather than a drilled system.

jog.personaBrief: His teams were built around technical creators (Luan, Arthur) and he values pace with intelligence in forwards, while also stressing set pieces and height in big games (Inter 2025).

bas.personaBrief: He likes working with academy players ('Ninguém é dono da camisa', six academy players in Gre-Nal 425) and young players were central in 2017, but he also recovers discarded veterans (Barrios, Cícero) and builds through signings.

lid.personaBrief: Management by dialogue and protecting the group (players rarely criticise him, 'nunca tive problema com meu grupo'), giving freedom and affection but fining when needed, and exempting a genuine star from duties.
